summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by editing files only; nothing was run or committed. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative depth-first walk, four cells of indent per level) and imports Measurement. rich/align.py constrains Align's wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width), adds Align.__repr__, and adds VerticalCenter with render, measurement, and repr. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in the collected render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased and adds an Added subheading with the two entries, keeping the existing markdown bullet. Tests added: test_measure_tree in tests/test_tree.py, and repr, render, and measure tests for Align/VerticalCenter in tests/test_align.py. Not verified: no tests or black formatting were run. The tree level counter briefly goes to -1 after the walk, which is harmless. The existing bullet sits above the Added subheading, a placement the spec left open.
